_readme: Bionic Passport destination data. Read by the server (app/engine.py) and by the browser fallback (static/engine.js). Every value has an evidence level and a source. Values with evidence 'Placeholder' are PLACEHOLDER, replace with sourced data. Values with "verified": false have a real source that still needs checking against the original document.

source.title: BIPM, 3rd CGPM (1901): standard acceleration of gravity

gravity_ms2.note: Continuous free fall: nothing has weight (microgravity).

source.title: Physics: orbital free fall
